features.name: Duplicate a project, save projects as boilerplates
features.description: Duplicate any project from the console (Projects → Duplicate, app menu, right-click), MCP (project_duplicate), REST (/api/projects duplicate), CLI (projects.mjs duplicate) or voice ('duplicate this project'): the copy gets the project's settings, build rules, skin, Claude accounts, plugin setup, manifest under the new name, rules and instructions, and its lists, to-dos, notes and plans as structure only (items and builds history optional). Save as boilerplate keeps any project as a named template shared across projects on the hub: list, rename, update from a project, delete (id typed, Brett can veto). The New project wizard asks Start from: blank, the current project, or a saved boilerplate, and its defaults follow that choice.
features.said: Duplicate project + save as boilerplate + wizard defaults: duplicate this project; save as boilerplate on any project, shared across projects; the New project wizard gets a Start from choice: blank, the current project, or any saved boilerplate.
